Our Process

How We Work

01

Consultation

Free site visit to discuss your vision, assess feasibility and provide initial guidance.

02

Design

Detailed plans and 3D visualisations. We work with architects to perfect every detail.

03

Planning

We handle all planning applications, building regulations and party wall agreements.

04

Build

Expert construction by our in-house team. Regular updates and a dedicated project manager.

05

Handover

Final snagging, deep clean and handover. Your project backed by our 10-year guarantee.
